claims.text: Experiments were performed on text-based games using the Go-Explore methodology, which extracts high-performing trajectories and trains a Seq2Seq model.
The experiments demonstrated that the Go-Explore approach outperforms existing solutions in solving text-based games and is more sample efficient.
The work presents an agent capable of state-of-the-art performance in playing text-based computer games, highlighting their complexity and the challenges they pose for learning agents.
